rows.note: Use this for broadening a scope, range, investigation, or area rather than merely making a physical object wider.

example.english: We need to widen the scope of the investigation before we can find the truth.
example.traditional: 我哋要擴大調查範圍，先至搵得出真相。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 kwong3 daai6 diu6 caa4 faan6 wai4 sin1 zi3 wan2 dak1 ceot1 zan1 soeng3

rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice when you make a physical thing wider.

example.english: Tailor, please widen the waistband a little.
example.traditional: 師傅，幫我整闊少少條褲頭呀。
example.jyutping: si1 fu2 bong1 ngo5 zing2 fut3 siu2 siu2 tiu4 fu3 tau4 aa3

rows.note: Use this when the thing itself has become wider, with 闊咗 functioning as the predicate.

example.english: The river has started to widen a lot.
example.jyutping: tiu4 ho4 fut3 zo2 hou2 do1
